_meta.purpose: Reverse lookup: wellness focus area -> associated nutrients -> juice/vegetable ingredients commonly rich in them
_meta.disclaimer: For educational and entertainment purposes only. Not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Nutrient associations reflect generally available public health information (e.g. NIH, USDA) and may not apply to your individual situation. Consult a doctor or registered dietitian before making dietary changes, especially if pregnant, nursing, on medication, or managing a medical condition.
